meta.name: gtars
meta.description: Use Gtars for local genomic interval models and set algebra, overlaps and counts, consensus and coverage, tokenization, fragment processing, and refget/BEDbase planning across Python, Rust, and the CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析基因组区间数据并进行集合运算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效处理基因组区间重叠、计数和覆盖等分析任务
copy.tagline_en: Analyze genomic interval data and perform set operations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need efficient analysis of genomic intervals including overlaps, counts, and coverage

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以处理基因组区间数据，包括检测重叠区域、生成覆盖度轨道、将基因组区域转为机器学习用的标记、以及处理单细胞片段文件等。
howto.when: 当用户需要分析基因组区间（如 BED 文件）、检测重叠区域、生成覆盖度数据、或进行基因组机器学习预处理时触发。

say.text: 帮我找出这两个BED文件重叠的区域。
say.note: 这将使用IGD索引进行重叠检测。

say.text: 用这些ATAC-seq片段生成BigWig覆盖度文件。
say.note: 调用uniwig模块生成覆盖度轨道。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can handle genomic interval data: detect overlaps, generate coverage tracks, tokenize genomic regions for ML, and process single-cell fragment files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users need to analyze genomic intervals (BED files), detect overlaps, generate coverage, or preprocess genomic data for machine learning.

say_en.text: Find overlapping regions between these two BED files.
say_en.note: Uses IGD indexing for overlap detection.

say_en.text: Generate a BigWig coverage file from these ATAC-seq fragments.
say_en.note: Calls the uniwig module to produce coverage tracks.
